dataList.title:
Selva Oscura
幽暗的森林
dataList.desc:
I stood in the middle of a black forest,
my reasons and past all lost to me.
All I had was a clock that replaced my head,
and a bus that emerged from the woods.
我站在一片幽暗森林的正中。
在此的原因与一切过去皆被遗忘。
我只剩下一个变成时钟的头，
和一辆冲出森林的巴士。

dataList.title:
The Outcast
无归属者
dataList.desc:
I was given the role of Manager.
My Guide instructed me to find a branch of gold, to which my head nodded.
Unknowingly,
I walked face-first into one of nightmares.
我成为了执行经理。
向导指示我去折下树枝。
我点头接受了。
此时我还不知道，
那是自噩梦中生长的树枝。

dataList.title:
The Unloving
无法去爱
dataList.desc:
Trespassers took the Golden Bough.
Sighing, the Guide offered another chance.
Determined to succeed this time,
we marched into a world
of pleasure and ice.
金枝被他人夺走了。
向导叹着气给了我们第二次机会。
我们抱着这次一定要成功的决心，
向欢乐与冰雪的世界进发。

dataList.title:
The Unconfronting
未曾面对
dataList.desc:
Curtains close on a blithe yet chilling comedy.
Afterward, I could vaguely sense
that a tragedy lies in wait.
The bus rumbled along.
In the window, I saw fall a silent night.
愉快却又冰冷的喜剧落下帷幕。
我隐约有预感，
接踵而至的将会是悲剧。
巴士伴随着路面的起伏而颠簸。
透过车窗，看到的是寂静的夜晚。

dataList.title:
The Unchanging
无改变者
dataList.desc:
We received our first request.
The excitement was short-lived as we watched chaos unfold in the middle of K Corp's Nest.
Time is winded as usual, and a pair of downcast eyes catch my attention.
我们第一次接到了委托。
愉快的氛围转瞬即逝，
K公司巢的中心沦为了修罗场。
时间一如既往地流逝，
某人低垂的眼眸突然映入眼帘。

dataList.title:
District 4 Branch Facility
4区L公司支部迷宫

District 10 Branch Facility
10区L公司支部迷宫

District 11 Branch Facility
11区L公司支部迷宫

Reminisced Fathoms of Ego
记忆中的自我心道

The Evil Defining
定义为恶
dataList.desc:
Amidst the conflict that knew no end,
We set sail on the Great Lake.
Into its ineffable Waves,
Into the flames of a certain wrath.
在冲突尚未和解之际，
我们向大湖扬帆启航，
驶入难以言喻的惊涛，
朝那怒火指引的地方。

dataList.title:
Into the Dark
步入黑暗

The Heartbreaking
心意相悖
dataList.desc:
The colors are fading,
and a storm is approaching.
Beyond the glass windows,
we see the wuthering heights.
颜色渐渐褪去，
狂风暴雨逼近。
在那车窗之外，
能看到暴风呼啸的山庄。

dataList.title:
The Tale of a Great Fixer Who Once Reached for The Dream
伟大的收尾人追求梦想的故事

The Dream Ending
梦之终焉
dataList.desc:
With our hearts leaden,
we disembark the train.
In me is a certain truth hidden,
forgotten even by whom it concerns.
怀抱着沉重的心情，
我们步下列车。
我隐瞒的那个事实，
连其主人都忘记了。

dataList.title:
The Surrendered Witnessing
不思观望
dataList.desc:
His watching Jade eye 
sees beyond where our visions lie.
Not yet knowing where the eye gazes,
I walk still, into where buildings make mazes.
他那玉色的眼瞳，
凝望着比我们更远的彼方。
我尚不知晓那视线的尽头，
便步入了建筑丛林之中。

dataList.title:
Second Round of the Family Hierarch Evaluation
第二轮家主评审

The Unsevering
无割舍者
dataList.desc:
Instead of the bus that never returned
came the news of an attack upon the unassailable.
Caught within the chaos,
I quietly behold what is wreathed there:
A spider's web, woven of red thread.
本应传来消息的巴士杳无音讯，
取而代之传来的却是，
那不可能被入侵的场所被袭击的消息。
在那混乱之中，
我静静地看着垂下的东西……
由赤红丝线所织就的，蜘蛛巢。

dataList.title:
The Gaze Bearing
凝视之下
dataList.desc:
Heavy do the gray chains rattle,
but the bound man holds his silence.
Struck by a sudden bout of vertigo,
I turned my gaze toward the sky.
The sun was beating down mercilessly.
灰色的锁链哗啦作响。
受缚之人仍默然相向。
我忽然感到一阵晕眩，
向天空抬头仰望。
唯有令人刺痛的阳光。
